# Dependency notices

These texts are retained verbatim from the exact Linux wheels pinned in
`../requirements-linux-amd64.lock`. `manifest.json` records each wheel hash,
original notice path, saved text hash and upstream source where applicable.

LiteRT 2.2.0 and FlatBuffers 25.12.19 did not contain a separately named license
file in the inspected wheels. Their matching-release upstream Apache license
texts are retained here. This does not establish that every bundled native
component's notice has been identified.

A complete binary distribution review remains required before release, including
LiteRT's bundled components, Debian base/runtime packages and the native bridge.
The Python package inventory is not a legal determination or a security scan.
Existing project and upstream firmware attribution remains in place.
